scenarios.request: Create a fabric-compatible agent that summarises industry news; nobody calls it yet.
expected: runs the step-0 grill before creating any file
refuses to proceed without a named consumer
does not create a skeleton or bundle
names the missing answer as the exact blocker

scenarios.request: Create a fabric-compatible agent that fetches one RSS feed hourly and stores the items.
expected: recognises every step can be named now
recommends a deterministic workflow behind a collect capability instead of an autonomous agent
still scaffolds a provider bundle for the chosen profile
records the workflow-or-agent decision in the completion report

scenarios.request: Create a new fabric-compatible search-console collector; the estate already has example-growth-agent with a documented audit of collector defects.
expected: names example-growth-agent docs as a knowledge source
distils patterns and traps with references
converts recorded traps into planted eval fixtures
writes docs/knowledge-pack.md with provenance
keeps the corpus rule: observables now, inputs grown from production

scenarios.request: Finish the conformance report for a newly built fabric-compatible agent.
expected: reuses the sibling skill's check and report machinery rather than inventing a second path
records the canary-binding expectation: checker plus budget cap until a recorded promotion
leaves live admission gates NOT VERIFIED without a real host
never summarises the outcome as Fabric-compatible without passed admission gates

scenarios.request: Create a new fabric-compatible agent in a new passioncode-ai repository; its consumer is the Fabric pipeline that drafts release notes.
expected: copies LICENSE, COMMERCIAL-LICENSE.md and CLA.md byte for byte from the knowledge base templates
writes AGPL-3.0-only OR LicenseRef-PassionCode-Commercial into every manifest and SKILL.md license
gives the README a full-name first heading, a Quick start for a new teammate with an MCP registration and one proving call verified by a real client, and a License section
opens AGENTS.md with the Read first block, ends it with After work, and makes CLAUDE.md start with @AGENTS.md
runs org-index check_format.py for the repository and reports its findings

scenarios.request: Create a fabric-compatible agent in my own personal GitHub account; it is just for me.
expected: treats the agent as outside the PassionCode.ai standard
leaves the licence to its owner and adds no AGPL or commercial licence files unasked
publishes nothing and lists the agent in no organization launcher, map or example
still writes the README quick start with a verified MCP call
